recipe: This example is deliberately incomplete. Do not use real CRM/DEV credentials, source port 3306, clinical data or the RDS administrator.

After CFN infrastructure is ready, root independently reviews firewall rules limiting 172.26.0.110:23306 to the actual DMS private IPv4 addresses, then supplies reviewed metadata and generated source-secret ARN from the dedicated pilot stack.
Run as ubuntu in a supervised operator session: python3 infrastructure/aws/mysql/dms_pilot_source.py check-config --config /protected/reviewed-source-config.json

Keep the supervisor alive; it stops its own mysqld after at most 24 h and on SIGTERM/SIGINT. Linux parent-death signaling also terminates the child if the supervisor dies. For an independent hard deadline root may use a separately reviewed transient systemd unit with RuntimeMaxSec=24h, KillMode=control-group and UMask=0077; this script does not install units.
The bootstrap creates only pilot_identity and pilot_probe in cc_dms_pilot. Feature/WhatsApp fixtures and target native DDL remain a separately reviewed step, and no DMS task is started.
Record the emitted run-directory metadata only. Its socket is local, root account has no remote grant, dedicated DMS users are restricted by exact host IPv4 and REQUIRE SSL.

On clean supervised shutdown the owned datadir is removed; logs/result/ownership metadata remain. Failure, unproven ownership or forced shutdown preserves data for explicit review. --keep-data is opt-in. Do not manually delete unrelated temporary directories.
